qt: to the Commission Özlem Demirel (The Left) Subject:

Frontex awards contracts for aerial surveillance under the aegis of its aerial surveillance service (FASS) and multipurpose aerial service (MAS) to service providers for aircraft and drones that are currently stationed in Italy, Malta and Greece. 1.
What was the financial value of the framework contracts for aerial surveillance that Frontex concluded or extended in 2024, and how were they split between manned and unmanned systems?
How many flight hours were ordered under these framework contracts, including all extensions?
What surveillance technology is on board the aircraft and drones operating on behalf of Frontex and who manufactured these aircraft?
at: EN on behalf of the European Commission (6.2.2025) As the question regarding ‘Aerial surveillance by the European Border and Coast Guard Agency (Frontex) with drones and aircraft (2024)’ falls entirely under the responsibility of Frontex, the Commission has asked the Agency to provide an answer to the questions raised by the Honourable Member. The Agency’s reply will be sent to the Honourable Member by the Commission as soon as possible.
